interface_rules: Pick one preferred substantive formula per single-prayer slot; give separate citations for identical copies in multiple historical books.
Do not copy a single composite 1905 French thanksgiving/offering to two different recitation stages; allow stage linkage and display once.
Preserve original prayer order as an independently identified historical preset, do not retroactively attribute an editorial assembly to a single manual.
Offer optional stages and Short/Complete routines, but never truncate a historically sourced prayer midway.
Time tracking is independent of prayer content: stopwatch by default, optional gentle duration or silent meditation, hide controls, no stage auto-advancement.
Do not claim English prayer source implies a verified FR/LA equivalent; show a sourced fallback or defer.
Historical private Confiteor with rubrical actor semantics is not automatically the priest's liturgical absolution.
Apply source rights and historical indulgence caveats before any publication.
review_gate: Select per-category defaults after more full-text witness certifications; do not mark the unverified alternatives as ready to ship.
